name: Entity Reference Display Formatter
description: renders an entity reference using a selectable display/view mode.
project_description:
This module provides a suite of interactive UI components Tabs, Accordions, and Anchors built specifically to work with the Paragraphs module. It allows content editors to create complex, organized layouts without writing a single line of code.

 Features: 
 
 Dynamic Tabs: Organize content into horizontal tabbed interfaces to save vertical space. 
 Smooth Accordions: Perfect for FAQs or collapsible content sections. 
 Auto-Anchors: Easily generate internal page links for improved navigation on long-form content. 
 Fully Nestable: Since it functions with Paragraphs, you can place any other paragraph type inside your tabs or accordions.
